question: with the overall scale frozen at the training estimate, can moving ONLY A and rho close the realised-volatility and absolute-return-autocorrelation gaps, and does it survive on 2022-2023?

what_is_frozen.sigma_annual_provenance: sd(S&P training returns) * sqrt(252) = 0.012118087297484344 * sqrt(252); the exact value is used, not a rounded 19.2%
what_is_frozen.note: no monitor, no EWMA, no earlier stage's configuration or output is touched, and mixed_noise is left exactly as it is

branches.sv_jump: SV + jumps, kappa and lambda at their stage-2 values

grid.boundary_rule: if the best cell sits on an edge of this grid that is RECORDED as a boundary result. The grid is not expanded to chase it.

objective.kind: finite-sample simulated-moment distance. NOT a likelihood, NOT a probability that the model is correct, NOT a calibrated significance test

group_1.expression: log of the realised-volatility quantile, so the comparison is proportional and the large quantile cannot dominate

objective.weights: the two groups carry equal total weight; inside a group the targets are averaged, so the group weight does not depend on how many targets it happens to contain
objective.scale_provenance: across-path standard deviation of each target under the STAGE 2 same-length reference simulation (sv_jump, matched scale, 2000 paths x 1258 days), fixed before this search. It is deliberately NOT recomputed per candidate: that would reward a candidate whose simulated spread happened to be wide
objective.comparison_point: the simulated MEDIAN across paths against the single sample value, at the same sample length

alternative_scales_not_used.why_recorded: one common scale set keeps the two branches comparable; the alternative differs by at most ~15%, and the branch ranking is re-checked against it

budget_and_seeds.screening_streams: COMMON RANDOM NUMBERS: every grid cell in a branch draws the same xi, z, K, w, so candidates are compared on the same noise
budget_and_seeds.final_streams: fresh and INDEPENDENT of the screening stream
budget_and_seeds.initialisation: the log-variance AR(1) starts from its stationary law
budget_and_seeds.no_post_hoc_rescaling: no path is rescaled after the draw to force a target mean, variance or Sharpe ratio

selection_rule.2: carry the best 3 cells per branch, plus the stage-2 baseline A=1.0, rho=0.98
selection_rule.3: re-evaluate each finalist on 2000 INDEPENDENT paths
selection_rule.4: estimate the Monte-Carlo standard error of the loss by resampling paths
selection_rule.5: select the lowest re-check loss. Any finalist within ONE Monte-Carlo standard error of the best is reported as part of a near-optimal SET; a unique optimum is not manufactured when the data cannot separate them

held_out_this_stage.auxiliary: P(RV_21 still above the training threshold 5 trading days later | above it today). Threshold fixed on the training sample; identical algorithm for market and simulation; state frequency, effective counts and the 16-day window overlap are all reported. This is a summary of a noisy observable, not a latent-state identification
held_out_this_stage.validation: 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31, read only AFTER the selected configuration is written to disk. All training parameters including the overall scale are frozen; the simulated length and every statistic window match the validation sample
held_out_this_stage.no_second_pass: the objective, the grid and the parameters are not revised in the light of the validation result. A validation failure is a deliverable conclusion

range_semantics: every simulated range is conditional on the chosen model AND the chosen parameters. It does not include parameter estimation uncertainty, and per-statistic coverage is not an overall pass rate
